notes.modules: Per-target topology uses the fixed stable reference and the current vector only. Score every proper branch, avoiding an arbitrary tree cut; at least two internal features and one external feature.
notes.screening: Continuous network project adaptation, not the published significance-screened full algorithm or a statistical DNB certification. No old discovery gate or old result is changed.
notes.small_panel: All ten prespecified features retained; no arbitrary top-quartile deletion of a small panel. Canonical feature order resolves linkage ties reproducibly.
notes.combined: A separate supervised warning model. Nonnegative weights preserve the prespecified risk directions; a useless network signal can receive zero weight. Do not call its accuracy pure DNB accuracy.
notes.penalties: Mean weighted logistic loss plus lambda/2 times squared slopes. Seven fixed decades cover weak to strong shrinkage after training-only scaling; development person-CV chooses the value, not test outcomes.
notes.validation: Existing outer person rotations and warning policy preserved. Each inner fold refits its scaler. Historical inspected simulation supports exploration, not clinical or fresh-test claims.
